name: Boo Boo the Fool
effect: On Reveal: Leave a Decoy here through next round. The next enemy character played or moved here takes 1 damage. If damage lands and Boo Boo is active, he moves to your weakest other open district and gains +1 Hand only if he arrives. One Decoy per side; each Boo Boo sets it once per match.
gap: Sherlock can watch the other two districts while Boo makes the home district costly to enter. A blocked trap spends itself and gives no escape reward.

name: Mr. Mc Hands
effect: On Reveal: Hit up to two different strongest enemy characters here for 2 damage each. Each strike separately respects defenses.
gap: Normal and tempo builds get a contested-lane closer with two separately defended strikes instead of another giant single hit.

name: Ms. Mary Mack
effect: Ongoing: The first positive Hands gain on another local ally each round gives Mary +1 Hand and your weakest ally in another district +1 Hand. Three payouts per side per match. Shared gains cannot trigger the rhythm again.
gap: Normal investment and relationship builds can turn one genuine local gain into help elsewhere. One payout per round, three total, and copied gains cannot make an infinite chain.

name: Pimp Swookie
effect: On Reveal: Weaken the strongest enemy here and place a Name Check on it through next round. Its next positive Hands gain is reduced by up to 2, then the check is spent. One check per side. Defenses apply; withheld gains are not damage.
gap: Poison gains a response to stacking Hands: temporarily disable the strongest enemy and withhold part of its next gain. Withheld gains do not create injury or damage-counter rewards.

name: OG Uncle Harley Davidson
effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other open district. Only if you arrive, gain +1 Hand and give your weakest other ally there +2 Hands.
gap: Earth and movement builds can put a strong body and a support payout into their weakest legal district. Both gains require actual arrival.

name: Suga Mama
effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other ally anywhere +2 Hands and Cleanse it. If its district is still trailing, Protect it.
gap: Light and relationship builds can support an ally anywhere, cleanse hostile statuses, and protect it when its district remains behind.

name: Side Chick
effect: On Reveal: Hit the strongest enemy Baby Momma anywhere for 3 damage and Weaken her in one hostile package. If no enemy Baby Momma is on the board, hit the strongest enemy here for 1 instead. Defenses apply.
gap: Specifically weakens an enemy Baby Momma across the board. Never attacks your Baby Momma; without an enemy Baby Momma, still has a local one-damage job.

name: Gas Station Window Wiper
effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other open district. Only if you arrive, hit its strongest enemy for 1.
gap: Water and movement builds get a one-Motion route starter whose attack requires reaching the destination. Useful alongside existing movement payoffs.

name: Parole Officer
effect: On Reveal: Put a movement-only Curfew on the strongest enemy here through next round. Post a Check-In here through next round: the first enemy character that moves here each round takes 2 damage. One Check-In per district per side. Defenses apply; Curfew can be cleansed.
gap: Sherlock control gets a separate way to restrict a threatening enemy and punish arrivals by movement. Its movement Curfew is temporary and cleanseable; it does not cancel an entrance that already resolved.

name: The Work Hubby
effect: On Reveal: Protect your weakest other ally here and give it a Lunch Bond through next round. Its next genuine Hands gain gives an active Work Hubby +1 Hand. One pending Bond per side; each Work Hubby issues one per match. Shared gains do not pay.
gap: Relationship and Normal investment get a low-cost bodyguard and a one-time gain payoff. Shared gains cannot repay Lunch Bond repeatedly.

name: The Guy She Told You Not to Worry About
effect: On Reveal: If the strongest enemy here has more Hands than this card, move it to its weakest other open district. Gain +2 Hands only if it arrives. Otherwise Protect your weakest other ally here. Defenses and capacity apply.
gap: Air and relationship pressure can pull a bigger body off the contested district. Blocked or illegal movement gives no self-buff; the alternative Protect keeps the card useful against smaller enemies.

name: Crazy Ex-Boyfriend
effect: On Reveal: Mark the strongest enemy anywhere for one chase at next round start. Move into its district if legal, then hit it for 2 only after arriving or if already there. In the final round, hit the strongest enemy here for 2 instead. One pending chase per side; each Ex books one per match.
gap: Dark and relationships get delayed pressure against a visible target. Enemy routing, source disabling, and capacity can stop the chase; the final-round local fallback avoids a dead timer.

name: Uncle Sam
effect: On Reveal: Confiscate up to 3 removable bonus Hands from the local enemy with the most bonus and gain the amount actually taken. Never takes printed Hands or creates healing credit. If nobody has bonus, Audit here through next round: the next enemy character played here costs +1 Motion. One pending Audit per side.
gap: Earth and control get an answer to removable bonus Hands. He steals only what is actually confiscated and never creates healing credit; uninvested boards instead receive a one-deployment Motion tax.

name: Apartment Maintenance Sage
ability: I GOT A KEY FOR THAT
effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest other ally here and remove its timed movement restriction, then move it to your weakest other open district. Protect it only if it arrives. Capacity, district detention and story closures still apply.
gap: Light, movement, and Sherlock control get a way to free an ally from a timed movement restriction and route it to a weak district. This also supplies the first leg of Fitness Circuit; it never bypasses capacity, district detention, or story closure.

name: The Bail Bonds Auntie
effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other local ally a Bail Bond through next round. Redirect its next targeted hostile ability to an active Auntie once. If she takes damage or a new harmful status, arm a credit through next round: your next Poison character played in another district refunds 1 Motion after a successful entrance. One Bond and credit per side.
gap: The original thirtieth entry fills Poison’s defensive tempo gap. A real hostile hit or newly applied harmful status must land on Auntie before the later successful off-district Poison entrance earns its refund.

name: The Opening Act
effect: On Reveal: Prepare your weakest other unlocked district through next round. Your next different Music character played there refunds 1 Motion after a successful entrance. One pending Soundcheck per side; one refund per side per match.
gap: Music gets a cheap opener that prepares a different district. Refund needs a different Music character with a successful real entrance; echoes and failed entrances cannot cash it out.

name: The DJ
effect: On Reveal: Return your weakest other movable Music character here costing 3 or less to hand. Its next deployment costs 1 less Motion, minimum 1, through next round. One successful Spinback per side per match; returning never resets limits.
gap: Music can replay one low-cost entrance while keeping ownership, progression, and once-only limits. The minimum-one deployment discount expires next round and cannot generate free infinite returns.

name: The Hype Man
effect: On Reveal: Call your weakest other Music ally anywhere through next round. Your next different Music character played in another district gives the caller and responder +1 Hand each and Protects the caller. One Call per side; caller and Hype Man must remain active.
gap: Music is rewarded for playing to another stage: caller and responder gain Hands, and the caller gets protection. Source and caller must remain active.

name: The Manager — Nice
effect: On Reveal: Insure your next other Music deployment through next round. If its entrance is canceled or queued by an enemy, refund 1 Motion once; otherwise Protect it after its entrance. That deployment spends the rider either way. One rider per side.
gap: Music can plan around Sherlock and enemy delays without undoing the counter. The next deployment spends the rider; either the actual interruption refunds one Motion or a normal entrance gets protection.

name: The Rapper
effect: Ongoing: Once per round, a different Music ally successfully resolving an entrance here makes Rapper hit the strongest local enemy for 1. Separately once per round, a successful Music entrance elsewhere gives the weakest ally there +1 Hand. Echoes do not count; copies share both limits.
gap: Music has a persistent reason to keep performing: local successful entrances pressure an enemy; remote ones support that stage. Separate shared once-per-round caps prevent a copied Rapper pile from multiplying every play.

name: The Janky Promoter
effect: On Reveal: Post a public bogus booking in the enemy’s weakest other unlocked district through next round. Their next character played or moved there takes 1 damage; only if damage lands, it is Weakened. The trap is spent even if blocked. One booking per side.
gap: Music can pressure an opponent’s weakest other district. The booking hits the next played or moved character and weakens only after real damage; Protection can spend it harmlessly.

name: The Local Celebrity
effect: Ongoing: Once per round, after an enemy actually damages a different friendly Music character in another district, move Celebrity there if legal. Gain +1 Hand only if the move succeeds. Copies share the trigger; blocked hits and friendly damage do not count.
gap: Music can react to an actual enemy hit on another performer. Celebrity must legally arrive before gaining Hands; a blocked hit or friendly damage gives no trigger.

name: The Battle Rapper
effect: On Reveal: Trim up to 2 bonus Hands from the strongest enemy here; if it has no bonus, hit it for 2 instead. If this changes the target, mark it through next round: its next positive Hands gain causes one Silence attempt. That gain remains. Protection and immunity apply.
gap: Music and Poison can trim investment or deal damage, then threaten a single Silence attempt after the victim’s next genuine gain. The gain stays and defenses still apply.

name: The Manager — Evil
effect: On Reveal: Give your strongest other local Music ally +3 Hands and prevent its movement through next round. At expiry, transfer up to 2 remaining bonus Hands to an active surviving Evil Manager. Cleansing cancels the contract without clearing other Locks. One contract per side; each client signs once per match.
gap: Music trades a client’s mobility for immediate strength, then transfers only surviving removable bonus into the manager. Cleansing cancels the deal; royalties are a transfer, not damage or injury.

name: The OG Rap Legend
effect: On Reveal: Repeat the weakest other active Music ally’s successful entrance, printed cost 3 or less, at its current district, then Protect it. Give the weakest Music ally in each other district +1 Hand. One Torch per side per match; once-only limits stay spent and passives are never repeated.
gap: A five-Motion finisher repeats one successful eligible Music entrance and supports other districts. It cannot repeat a passive, unsuccessful entrance, higher-cost artist, or reopen once-only refunds.

name: Fitness Bro
effect: Ongoing: At round end, if you played another character in a different district this round, gain +2 Hands and record one Rep. At three Reps, gain Protection and stop. One Rep per round, up to three per match; copies share progress. Supports, tokens and echoes do not count.
gap: Fitness and Normal gain a three-rep engine for playing other characters in other districts. Three real rounds earn six Hands and Protection; supports, tokens, and echoes do not count.

name: Fitness Girl
effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other open district. After a successful move, restore up to 2 actual damage and remove Burn from your weakest injured other ally there. If nobody is injured, remove Burn from your weakest burning other ally there instead. A failed move gives no recovery.
gap: Water and Fitness can recover real recorded damage and clear Burn after a successful route. It does not convert bonus removal into healing or indiscriminately cleanse other statuses.

name: Personal Trainer
effect: On Reveal: Train your weakest other ally here through next round. Its first successful move out gains +2 Hands. Its first later visit to the remaining third district gains +2 Hands and Protection. One circuit per side; each character can train once per match. Moving between only two districts never finishes.
gap: Movement decks gain a clear circuit objective: a first route pays two Hands and visiting the remaining third district pays two plus Protection. Bouncing between two districts cannot complete it.

name: Demon Trainer
effect: Ongoing: The first other friendly Fitness character destroyed by an enemy each round gives Demon +2 Hands and hits the strongest enemy in the fallen athlete’s district for 1. At most two payouts per side per match. Demon must already be active; sacrifices, tokens and friendly damage never count.
gap: Fitness and Fire can turn two actual enemy-caused athlete losses into bounded revenge. Demon must already be active, and nonlethal hits, your sacrifices, and tokens do not count. Four Motion lets the comeback engine enter before the final round.

name: Nail Tech
effect: On Reveal: Give another friendly card here +2 Hands. The next time that card is hit by an enemy Hands reduction, reduce that loss by 1. Ongoing: While Nail Tech is in your hand, your other Poison characters on the board gain +1 Hands at round end.
gap: Fresh Set keeps the existing save key, abilities, upgrades, and Poison identity. The art refresh matches the supplied Nail Tech; she provides neutral investment protection to Fitness and remains a Poison hand-support option.
